author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
We need to have new kind of software that can self heal with AI. The AI is part of the software deliverable.

In pre-AI era, you write the code, test, build and ship. Then the software suppose to work flawlessly in the user's hand, otherwise it is a bug

With AI, we can ship a software that is mostly right, if it sees an edge case it is not tested before in the user environment, call AI to fix the code on the fly.

We can say, it is NOT a bug, it is a feature.
